headline: Udayshivakumar Infra submits AGM scrutinizer's report to exchanges
hook: Procedural filing on AGM voting results
summary: Udayshivakumar Infra Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine regulatory filing detailing the voting results of shareholder resolutions. The submission complies with SEBI listing obligations for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock face no immediate material impact from this administrative update.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
